answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The delta of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the garden until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wharf of the next round.
